correctness.rationale: Itô multiplication yields the exact positive-semidefinite-preserving covariance flow (3). Permutation-invariant initial covariance reduces it to the explicit two-by-two matrix (4). The PSD order comparison \(xx^{\mathsf T}\preceq\|x\|^2I\) proves the reduced exponent governs uniform mean-square stability of every vector; no hidden symmetry-sector instability is possible. Trace, determinant, and explicit eigenvectors give the exact iff boundary, equality behavior, and optimal exponent. Independent exact-rational checker tests passed 84 full moment identities and 632 characteristic sign comparisons; the sample has full moment eigenvalues \((-8\pm2\sqrt{13})/9\), \(-20/9\).

value.rationale: The paper uses its claimed mean-square threshold to assert a dimensional tipping point. The exact replacement shifts the critical diversity ceiling, not just a decimal coefficient, and explicitly reverses stability for the allowed integer \(s=2\) in a parameter regime satisfying the paper’s threshold assumptions. The theorem supplies a sharp spectral growth rate and identifies negative cross-covariance as the stabilizing mechanism. A complete arbitrary-species criterion for the exact model is directly useful when judging the stated ecological linear stability claims; it is more than a type or normalization check.
